name: gpu-rma-v2
description: GPU-only PSU RMA load profile. CPU idle throughout — isolates 12V GPU rail(s). Four 7-min sustained windows separated by 30s idle drops for transient load-step evidence (8 edges total: 4 up, 4 down). Uses tensor cores + large VRAM matrix for max sustained power. No software power cap — expects native GPU TGP + documented transient spikes. Intended for 1000W+ benches where CPU is held idle to stay within envelope.

phases.name: baseline
phases.notes: 60s idle baseline. Capture reference rail voltages, GPU temps/clocks, fan RPMs. Multimeter idle read goes here.

phases.name: gpu-load-1
phases.notes: 7 min GPU max load, CPU idle. Load-step up #1. Tensor cores + 4096 matrix — max power, max VRAM bandwidth.

phases.name: idle-1
phases.notes: 30s idle drop. Load-step down #1 — ~575W instantaneous drop on 12V GPU rail. Watch for overshoot, ringing, rail recovery time.

phases.name: gpu-load-2
phases.notes: 7 min GPU max load. Load-step up #2. Second sustained window — thermal hysteresis check vs cycle 1.

phases.name: gpu-load-3
phases.notes: 7 min GPU max load. Load-step up #3. Third sustained window — capacitor fatigue starts showing here on marginal PSUs.

phases.name: gpu-load-4
phases.notes: 7 min GPU max load. Load-step up #4. Final sustained window — if anything is going to droop from thermal soak, it shows by now.

phases.name: recovery
phases.notes: 60s idle recovery. Rails should return to baseline within a few seconds. Drift vs baseline = marginal PSU. Multimeter post-test read goes here.
